description: November 5 birthday meaning: Scorpio decan 2, birthday number 5, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a November 5 birthday falls in Scorpio, in the second decan, with Pluto as the sign's ruler and Neptune as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 5. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Scorpio is fixed and water.

sections.heading: Personality of a November 5 birthday
paragraphs: Bonfire Night birthdays sit at about twelve degrees of Scorpio, where Neptune sub-rules the second decan. Five is numerology's number of change, risk and sensation, giving November 5 a restless, magnetic quality. The combined reading is someone drawn to intense experiences and new horizons, who learns most about themselves by venturing a little beyond the familiar.

By noon UTC on November 5, the Sun has normally reached roughly 12° of Scorpio. That places the date in the Scorpio decan that astrologers give to Neptune, the second of three. From 10 to 19 degrees of Scorpio, the sub-ruler is Neptune, modern ruler of Pisces. Early-to-mid November birthdays tend to soften the sign's intensity with intuition, imagination and empathy. These Scorpios are often seen as perceptive in an almost uncanny way, reading undercurrents in a room and drawn to art, healing work or spiritual questions. Neptune can blur edges, so feelings may be absorbed from others or idealised beyond recognition. The combination is powerful when grounded: deep emotional insight paired with compassion, used to help people face what they would rather not see alone.

sections.heading: Numerology of the November 5 birthday
paragraphs: Born on the 5th, your birthday number is 5, sitting at the exact midpoint of the single digits. Numerologists read the day of birth as a secondary note, a personal knack rather than a fixed fate. The 5 is linked with movement, the senses and curiosity, so a 5th birthday is traditionally associated with adaptability and a low tolerance for monotony. These people often learn fastest by doing and enjoy travel, variety and new company. Freedom matters to them, and so does choosing which commitments are worth the trade, since restlessness can otherwise scatter a great deal of energy.

Because the year enters the Life Path calculation, the same November 5 birthday leads to different paths across generations, among them 7 for 1980, 8 for 1990, 9 for 2000 and 1 for 2010. Some birth years on this date reach the master numbers 11 and 22. The Life Path calculator does the reduction for any year.

sections.heading: November 5 in context: the season, Chinese zodiac and famous birthdays
paragraphs: A November birthday falls in late autumn for the northern hemisphere, a season of bare branches and early dusk, and in late spring for the southern, when the days lengthen fast. Scorpio holds most of the month, with Sagittarius arriving around November 22. In numerology November is month 11, a master number that is traditionally kept unreduced and linked with intuition and inspiration. November 5 is the 309th day of the year (310th in a leap year). In most years Sagittarius season is under way by November 23, 18 days after this birthday.

Chinese astrology is straightforward for a November 5 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies. November 5 is also the birthday of Vivien Leigh (1913), Bryan Adams (1959) and Vandana Shiva (1952).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is November 5?
faq.answer: November 5 is Scorpio in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the second decan of Scorpio, which tradition links with Neptune.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on November 5?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On November 5 the Life Path is 5 in 1960, 6 in 1970, 7 in 1980, 8 in 1990, 9 in 2000, 1 in 2010 and 2 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 5 for everyone born on the 5th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on November 5?
faq.answer: By November 5 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on November 5?
faq.answer: Among the best-known people with a November 5 birthday are Vivien Leigh (1913), Bryan Adams (1959) and Vandana Shiva (1952). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
